messages.subject: unmarkedFramePCount - Error in obsCovs[[i]] : attempt to select less than one element
parts:
Hi everyone,


I'm trying to run the N-mixture model with pcount and I need to set my
data with unmarkedFramePCount.

I have some environmental covariates that I included with siteCovs and
some temporal covariates (vary between surveys (sampling periods) but
not within each survey) that I want to included with obsCovs.

yumf<-unmarkedFramePCount(y,siteCovs=site.cov) works fine but when I
add the obsCovs:
CUMF<-unmarkedFramePCount(y=C,siteCovs=siteCovs,obsCovs=obs.cov), I
get this error that I don't understand:
Error in obsCovs[[i]] : attempt to select less than one element

I defined obs.cov as written in the pdf Package 'unmarked':
obs.cov<-list(cov1,cov2,cov3).
Each cov is a dataframe of n.sites rows and n.surveys columns.

Is it because my covariates do not vary within each survey (same value
for all the sites for one survey) ?
If so how can I include them ?

Thanks a lot

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: unmarkedFramePCount - Error in obsCovs[[i]] : attempt to select less than one element
parts:
It looks like you need to fix the names of "siteCovs" and add names to "obs.covs". Currently, if you type:

colnames(siteCovs)

I think you will see "dshor[,1]" and "dudvlp[,1]" instead of "dshor" and "dudvlp". You can give the list names using:

names(obs.cov) <- c("peak", "airt", "wind")


Then try putting the pieces together again.

Richard
